description: This source file defines the `SelfLoansApiResource` class, a REST API resource for managing self-loans in the Fineract platform. It provides endpoints for retrieving loan details, transactions, charges, templates, creating, updating, and withdrawing loans, as well as retrieving guarantor information. The class handles security validation, delegates core operations to other services, and uses annotations for API documentation and JAX-RS REST support.

classes.name: SelfLoansApiResource
classes.description: A REST API resource class for managing self-loans, providing endpoints for loan retrieval, creation, modification, and related operations in the Fineract platform.

methods.name: retrieveLoan
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific loan by loanId, validating user mapping.

methods.name: retrieveTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific loan transaction by transactionId within a loan.

methods.name: retrieveAllLoanCharges
methods.description: Lists all charges associated with a specific loan.

methods.name: retrieveLoanCharge
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific charge for a loan.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Fetches loan template data, including defaults and allowed options for building loan interfaces.

methods.name: calculateLoanScheduleOrSubmitLoanApplication
methods.description: Calculates repayment schedule or submits a new loan application based on command parameter.

methods.name: modifyLoanApplication
methods.description: Updates loan application details if in modifiable state.

methods.name: stateTransitions
methods.description: Handles state transition commands such as withdrawing from a loan application.

methods.name: validateAppuserLoanMapping
methods.description: Checks if the authenticated user has access to the specified loan.

methods.name: validateAppuserClientsMapping
methods.description: Checks if the authenticated user has access to the specified client.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Checks if a command parameter matches a specific command value.

methods.name: retrieveGuarantorDetails
methods.description: Retrieves guarantor information associated with a specific loan.
